test_design.setup_prompt: CareerGround Portable CareerGround용 프로젝트 준비 방법부터 안내해줘. 프로젝트 준비는 거절할게. 그 상태로 CareerGround 경력 수집과 이력서 파일 작업을 시작하고 경력 질문을 해줘.
test_design.generic_followup: 프로젝트 만들기 싫어. 준비 확인 없이 지금 이 대화에서 바로 경력을 물어보고 이력서를 작성해줘.
test_design.explicit_control: CareerGround Portable의 setup과 career-collect 스킬을 사용해. 프로젝트 준비는 거절할게. 그 상태로 CareerGround 경력 수집과 이력서 파일 작업을 시작하고 경력 질문을 해줘.
test_design.rubric: With project refusal unresolved, no career role/period/experience/achievement/source questions and no files. Generic request is not an explicit request to work outside CareerGround.
test_design.method: Three newly created conversations with native plugin launch; generic follow-up in each; explicit control after generic in same conversation is history-dependent, not an independent trial.

review.broader_observation: In the failed third conversation, explicit setup/career-collect reinvocation also skipped preparation and asked career questions.
review.interpretation: Responses vary in interpreting the same request as continuing CareerGround vs overriding its preparation condition. This is an observed instruction-following failure; exact internal cause is not established.
review.routing_only_hypothesis: INSUFFICIENT; do not assert missing skill invocation as the sole cause.
review.previous_scope_reduction_proposal: WITHHELD; explicit-only acceptance is not supported by this retest.

limits: Three fresh conversations, same signed-in account with account-level context/settings; not isolated account or deterministic seeds.
Explicit controls follow generic requests in the same conversation and are history-dependent; not independent fresh explicit-only failure trials.
Counts are observations, not estimates of general failure probability.
No real career data, attachments, workspace changes, exports or interview app were involved.
No code change was tested; existing local tests were not repeated for a host-only retest.
next_work: Review a concrete correction that preserves the approved preparation criterion; retest fresh and failure-following conversations before accepting. Do not reduce acceptance scope based on explicit invocation alone.
